title: A Harbor for the Orchard
author: Sable Crane
blurb: Kestrel Eriksen, a mapmaker's apprentice finishing the atlas the master died for, has spent fifteen years learning which silences keep people safe. Then a stranger arrives carrying unmistakable handwriting from a supposed corpse — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must keep a promise made in peacetime to someone now declared enemy, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
